PHASE 1.description: Slither wrapper & fixture setup (3-5 Ethernaut challenges, 1 control contract)

PHASE 3.description: LLM-judge economic-logic layer with DamnVulnerableDeFi fixtures

history.description: Implemented Slither wrapper with schema normalization and added Ethernaut challenge fixtures and a clean control contract. Fixed security risk by removing shell=True from subprocess run in slither_wrapper.py.

Built run_mythril wrapper with fallback mechanism, implemented findings reconciliation algorithm, and updated tests to verify merging overlapping findings. Improved wrapper robustness by preventing argument injection (contract_path starting with '-') and narrowing subprocess exception handling to log execution/JSON errors while silently ignoring missing tool command scenario.

Fixed input handling in run_mythril by calling .strip() on contract_path before argument-injection check. Wrapped fallback file-reading block in a try-except statement for FileNotFoundError, PermissionError, and UnicodeDecodeError to gracefully return accumulated findings.

Refined slither_wrapper.py and mythril_wrapper.py to remove redundant os.path.exists checks in favor of direct file access validation within try-except blocks, and extended the argument-injection check to check for Unicode dash equivalents (−, –, —).

Applied final security fixes to both slither_wrapper.py and mythril_wrapper.py by resolving the absolute path via os.path.abspath at the beginning, checking for dash/dash-equivalent prefixes on the basename as a defense-in-depth measure, and caching file content in memory in mythril_wrapper.py to prevent TOCTOU during fallback analysis.

Cloned 3 DamnVulnerableDeFi challenges (NaiveReceiverLenderPool, TrusterLenderPool, and SideEntranceLenderPool) as fixtures under fixtures/dvd, implemented review_economic_logic function with API key check and pattern-matching fallback, and updated the test wrapper to integrate and evaluate the LLM judge findings.
Refined economic_logic_judge.py to add type validation in _parse_llm_json, normalize severity/confidence keys, and restrict contract_source payload to a maximum length threshold.

Created report_generator.py to compile and format findings grouped by tool with trust-tagged notes and disclaimers. Built run_pipeline.py as the end-to-end validation runner which executes Slither, Mythril, and the LLM judge over the complete fixtures set, evaluates recall, and outputs RESULTS.md.
